about: Organisation email formats (docs/methodology/contact-research.md, 'Email formats', 11 October 2026). Written by scripts/contacts/email_formats.py build --write from published addresses in committed sources; reviewed before commit. Evidence is stored as the pattern each published address shows, the person's record, the source URL and the date read, never as an address. Only 'confirmed' formats (two or more people, one pattern) generate candidates, and those are written to runtime/ only, labelled 'inferred from format, unverified', always low confidence.
